column1: # The servers this engine's committed answers come from. default judges
# compat.tsv and records the tapes: SQL Server 2022 CU27 GDR, whose source
# tag is the version it reports (SERVERPROPERTY('ProductVersion')). Its rows
# are generated from TSql160.g4, converted from ScriptDOM's TSql160.g (the
# T-SQL parser for compatibility level 160, SQL Server 2022) at
# beside this file byte for byte, MIT (ScriptDom.LICENSE). scriptdom is
# the .NET SDK image mssql/scriptdom's harness builds and runs in, and the
# ScriptDOM package version harness.csproj references; it records the
# tapes of the tests that compare omni with ScriptDOM.
# columns: role, image, digest, source tag
